activate.failedTitle: The current release was not changed

documents.info: Upload business documents and follow their parsing status and AI analysis results.

review.info: Review change sets item by item: accept, edit or reject each change. Only approved changes enter the ontology.

ontology.info: Browse object types, relations, properties, constraints and advanced axioms as a graph or a list. Select an element to see its details and where it came from.

data.info: Connect data sources, browse table catalogs and bind data to the ontology.

explore.info: Browse business objects by ontology, follow relations or ask questions in natural language.
explore.emptyDescription: Here you will browse business objects by ontology, trace them along relations and ask AI questions.

releases.info: Publish immutable releases, export Turtle, and make an earlier release current again when needed.
